title: Karbala Karbala Karbala Aagayi
body:
Karbala Karbala Karbala Aagayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Rashke Jannat Hai Ye Sar Zameen-e-Wafa
Khoone Masoom Se, Isko Seencha Gaya
So Raha Hai Yahan, Dilbare Fatima
Aankh Bhar Aayi Jab Uski Yaad Aagayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Kam Nahin Hai Haram Se Ye Dashte Sitam
Aankh Neechi Rahen, Sar Rahein Sab Ke Kham
Sar Khulay Yaan Se Guzre Hain Ahle Haram
Ghudkiyan Khaati Roti Sakina Gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Zarra Zarra Hai Ik, Dastaane Alam
Khoon Hi Khoon Bikhra Hai Taaba Haram
Ai Dil-e-Natawa Rakh Sambhal Ke Qadam
Sayyada Yaan Se Hai Paa Barehna Gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Ranjo Gham Jinke Guzre Na The Paas Se
Teen Din Tak Tadapte Rahe Pyaas Se
Shaah Dekha Kiye Hasrato Yaas Se
Har Kali Baaghe Zehra Ki Kumla Gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaam Se Jabke Palta Huwa Qafila
Manzile Maarta Phoncha Karbobala
Girke Naaqe Sai Zainab Ne Di Ye Sada
Qaid Se Chut Ke Bhaiya Bahen Aagayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Zainab Kahan Aur Kahan Reesuma
Mou Chupane Ko Batlao Jaaoun Kahan
Mujhse Chupte Nahin Baazuon Ke Nishaan
Qaid Hone Se Pehle Na Mout Aagayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Tha Yahin Mere Akbar Ko Naiza Laga
Halqe Asghar Yahin Teer Se Tha Chida
Haan Issi Khaak Par Tha Sare Sheh Kata
Yeh Zameen Saara Kunba Mera Kha Gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Godiyon Main Nabi Zaadiyon Ke Pale
Jaan Dene Pe Is Tarhan Se The Tule
Rak Diye Khushk Raiti Pe Pyaase Gale
Burrish-e-Khanjar-e-Zulm Sharmagayi
